title: 1996 Summer Olympics
content: The 1996 Summer Olympics were held in Atlanta, Georgia, United States.

title: United States currency 1996
content: The currency of the United States in 1996 was the United States dollar, ISO code USD.

title: 2000 Summer Olympics
content: The 2000 Summer Olympics were held in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia.

title: Australia currency 2000
content: The currency of Australia in 2000 was the Australian dollar, ISO code AUD.

title: 2004 Summer Olympics
content: The 2004 Summer Olympics were held in Athens, Greece.

title: Greece currency 2004
content: The currency of Greece during the 2004 Games was the euro, ISO code EUR.

title: 2012 Summer Olympics
content: The 2012 Summer Olympics were held in London, United Kingdom.

title: United Kingdom currency 2012
content: The currency of the United Kingdom in 2012 was pound sterling, ISO code GBP.

title: 2016 Summer Olympics
content: The 2016 Summer Olympics were held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

title: Brazil currency 2016
content: The currency of Brazil in 2016 was the Brazilian real, ISO code BRL.
